using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData;
using Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Data;
using Xunit;

namespace Microsoft.SemanticKernel.Test;

public class TextSearchServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
{
    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_WithoutVectorSearch_ThrowsInvalidOperationException()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();

        // Act & Assert
        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<string>());
        Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(() => services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<string>(serviceId: "test"));
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_WithVectorSearch_RegistersKeyedTransient()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var mockVectorSearch = new Mock<IVectorSearchable<string>>();
        services.AddSingleton<IVectorSearchable<string>>(mockVectorSearch.Object);

        // Act
        services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<string>();

        // Assert
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var textSearchFactory = serviceProvider.GetService<IKnownKeyedService<VectorStoreTextSearch<string>>>();

        Assert.NotNull(textSearchFactory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_WithKeyedVectorSearchId_ThrowsWhenNotFound()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();

        // Act & Assert
        var exception = Assert.Throws<InvalidOperationException>(
            () => services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<string>("nonexistent"));
        Assert.Equal("No IVectorSearch<TRecord> for service id nonexistent registered.", exception.Message);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_WithValidKeyedVectorSearchId_RegistersSuccessfully()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var mockVectorSearch = new Mock<IVectorSearchable<string>>();
        services.AddKeyedSingleton<IVectorSearchable<string>>("test", mockVectorSearch.Object);

        // Act
        services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<string>("test");

        // Assert
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var textSearchFactory = serviceProvider.GetService<IKnownKeyedService<VectorStoreTextSearch<string>>>();

        Assert.NotNull(textSearchFactory);
    }

    [Fact]
    public void AddVectorStoreTextSearch_ResolvesNullDependenciesFromServiceProvider()
    {
        // Arrange
        var services = new ServiceCollection();
        var mockVectorSearch = new Mock<IVectorSearchable<string>>();
        var mockStringMapper = new Mock<ITextSearchStringMapper>();
        var mockResultMapper = new Mock<ITextSearchResultMapper>();
        var mockOptions = new VectorStoreTextSearchOptions();

        services.AddSingleton<IVectorSearchable<string>>(mockVectorSearch.Object);
        services.AddSingleton<ITextSearchStringMapper>(mockStringMapper.Object);
        services.AddSingleton<ITextSearchResultMapper>(mockResultMapper.Object);
        services.AddSingleton(mockOptions);

        // Act
        services.AddVectorStoreTextSearch<string>();

        // Assert - Service registration succeeds when all dependencies are available
        var serviceProvider = services.BuildServiceProvider();
        var textSearchFactory = serviceProvider.GetService<IKnownKeyedService<VectorStoreTextSearch<string>>>();
        Assert.NotNull(textSearchFactory);
    }
}
